description: Start a background job that replays a compiled .flow.ts against the app, repairs drifted steps and stages a checked candidate as a proposal file for review (repair --propose); never rewrites the spec. Returns a job_id: poll job_status. Apply a good proposal with repair_apply.

cwd.description: Project directory (absolute) the command runs in; sitelooper.config.json is found from here. Default: the server's working directory.

proposal_file.description: Where to write the proposal JSON (must not exist yet).

vars.description: Flow variables, passed as repeated --var k=v. "{n}" in a value is replaced per run with a fresh value. Never a secret: use {{env:NAME}} markers in instructions instead.

name: repair_propose
